title_ru: Eye in the Sky — ответ Hawkar: сила не для власти, а чтобы подняться и помочь подняться другим
title_en: Eye in the Sky — Hawkar's answer: power is not to rule, but to rise and help others rise

provenance.origin: The user directly supplied the final English wording in conversation and explicitly requested that it be entered into the JANUS Meta Registry as his answer.
provenance.draft_history: An earlier assistant-drafted version preceded this final wording. This artifact treats the user's directly supplied English text as authoritative.

addressed_symbol.subject: The Alan Parsons Project — Eye in the Sky
addressed_symbol.interpretive_prompt: If the controlling or all-seeing voice associated with Eye in the Sky were addressing the author personally, this is the author's answer.
addressed_symbol.boundary: This is a personal and symbolic response to a song persona and theme. It does not claim that the song literally addresses the author.

response.authoritative_text:
You can watch from above.
You may think you're reading my mind.
You can see my mistakes, fear, anger and how many times I fell.
But you don't make the rules of my soul.
I've already been there where power turns into fear, and fear into the desire to control everything.
I chose a different path.
I don't want power over people.
I want power over my own shadow.
I don't want to be the eye that watches.
I want to be the hand that lifts.
Are you saying you see right through me?
Then watch carefully.
I'm still here.
I chose life.
I chose love.
I got up.
And if I am given power, it will serve not control, but life.
You are Eye in the Sky.
And I'm still learning to fly.
THE POWER IS NOT TO RULE.
THE POWER IS TO RISE — AND HELP OTHERS RISE.

janus_semantics.power_gate_ru: Сила не даёт права устанавливать правила чужой души. Первый объект силы — собственная тень: страх, гнев и желание контролировать.
janus_semantics.power_gate_en: Power does not grant the right to set the rules of another person's soul. Its first object is one's own shadow: fear, anger, and the desire to control.
janus_semantics.lifting_hand_ru: Высота не должна превращаться во всевидящий надзор. Предпочтение отдаётся руке, которая поднимает, а не оку, которое следит.
janus_semantics.lifting_hand_en: Height must not become all-seeing control. The preferred symbol is the hand that lifts rather than the eye that watches.
janus_semantics.life_gate_ru: Ответ завершается выбором жизни, любви и подъёма. Полученная сила должна служить жизни, а не контролю.
janus_semantics.life_gate_en: The answer ends in the choice of life, love, and rising again. Any power received must serve life rather than control.

god_power_boundary.meaning: GOD POWER remains the author's personal spiritual language for strength, hope, will to live, and power directed toward life and creation.
